Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Publish
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      snapshot_only:
        description: Run the snapshot publishing job without the regular release job
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  snapshot:
    if: ${{ !contains(github.event.commits[0].message, 'nosnapshot') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Snapshot
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: check skip tag
        run: |
          if git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -qE 'chore: release|nosnapshot'; then
            echo "Skipping snapshot release due to commit message."
            exit 0
          fi

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            **/node_modules
            ./.yarn/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Set up Yarn
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@4.1.1 --activate

      - run: yarn
      - run: yarn lint:test
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build:core
      - run: yarn build:web

      - name: Copy readme.md to packages
        run: |
          for dir in $(find packages -type d -maxdepth 1); do
            cp readme.md $dir/readme.md
          done
          
      - name: Snapshot Versioning
        run: yarn changeset version --snapshot

      - name: Snapshot Release
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            exit 0
          else
            yarn changeset publish --no-git-tag --tag snapshot
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}


  publish:
    if: ${{ !inputs.snapshot_only && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[snapshot-only]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Publish
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            **/node_modules
            ./.yarn/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Set up Yarn
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@4.1.1 --activate

      - run: yarn
      - run: yarn lint:test
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build:core
      - run: yarn build:web
      - name: Copy readme.md to packages
        run: |
          for dir in $(find packages -type d -maxdepth 1); do
            cp readme.md $dir/readme.md
          done

      - name: Create Release Pull Request or Publish to npm
        id: changesets
        uses: changesets/action@v1
        with:
          version: npx zx ./scripts/version.mjs
          publish: yarn changeset publish
          commit: "chore: release [nosnapshot]"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
